wwm.label: What we offer
wwm.title: Floorball Skill Training in Uster
wwm.p1: The Improve your skills Skill Training is our day camp for young players – led by three Swiss national team players, in small groups with personal feedback.

header.title: About us.
header.subtitle: Three national team players. One shared idea.

ansatz.label: Our Approach
ansatz.title: Giving something back.
ansatz.lead: We've all benefited from great role models and good coaches. Now it's our turn to pass that knowledge on.
ansatz.p: The Skill Training is more than just sport – it's a chance to show kids what's possible when you train with purpose and believe in yourself. We bring experience from the national team and Europe's top clubs straight to the hall in Uster.
ansatz.feature1Text: Stick handling, shooting, movement – improved with purpose
ansatz.feature2Text: Max. 30 kids – every child gets personal feedback
ansatz.feature3Text: National team players with years of competitive experience

impressum.title: Legal Notice.
impressum.eventBody:
Floorball Skill Training 2026 – «Improve your skills»
Buchholz Sporthalle, 8610 Uster
Date: 4 July 2026
impressum.privacyP1: Protecting your personal data is important to us. As part of the Floorball Skill Training 2026, the following data is collected: name, contact details, and possibly photo and video recordings of participants. This data is used solely to organise and run the event.
impressum.privacyP2: Photo rights: Photos and video clips may be taken during the training. These serve as keepsakes for families and are not published online, on social media, or on this website without explicit consent. If any recordings are used for promotional purposes or on the website, we obtain separate, written consent from the parent or guardian beforehand. Any recordings for which no further use has been agreed are deleted after the event.
impressum.privacyP3: Data sharing: Personal data is not shared with third parties. The exception is technical processing by our service providers (e.g. payment processing via Payrexx), who are themselves bound by data protection law.
impressum.privacyP4: If you have any questions about data protection, our team is happy to help at any time:
impressum.liabilityBody: The organisers accept no responsibility for the accuracy, completeness, or currency of the information provided on this website. Liability claims for damages of a material or immaterial nature are generally excluded.
impressum.copyrightBody: All content on this website is protected by copyright. Use without the express permission of the organisers is not permitted.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy.
datenschutz.draftNotice: This page is a draft and has not yet been legally reviewed. The full version will follow in a later phase of the website relaunch.
datenschutz.intro: This page describes what happens to your data when you use the contact form on improveyourskills.ch.
datenschutz.formBody: When you fill out the contact form, we store your first name, last name, email address and message in order to answer your request. We also store a checksum (hash) of your IP address to prevent abuse from automated requests — never the IP address itself.
datenschutz.accessBody: Only the administrators of this website (see legal notice) can see the stored messages.
datenschutz.processorsBody: Supabase (database, EU region) stores the message. Resend sends the notification and confirmation emails. Cloudflare Turnstile checks that a human, not a bot, submitted the form.
datenschutz.retentionBody: Not yet finally determined — will follow with the full version of this page.
datenschutz.contactBody: For questions about data protection, you can reach us via the contact form or the details in the legal notice.
